summary: Frontend-only verification of new AI-credits balance pill in the header of all 5 Emotional Gatekeeper tool screens (eg-trap, eg-loop, eg-limitation, eg-aim, eg-session). Pre-created one EG session per type via API, seeded auth token (super_admin veales) into localStorage, navigated to each tool screen on mobile viewport (390x844). All 5 screens rendered cleanly with NO red error overlay, headers display the expected title, and the AI-credits pill (sparkles icon + numeric balance '921') is visible in the top-right of the header next to the back button on every screen. Backend GET /api/ai-wallet returns 200 with {balance:920.54, is_admin:true, unit:'credits', tokens_per_credit:100} and the pill correctly formats this to 921 (toFixed(0) since balance >= 10). Regression check passed: prior '~N cr' estimate badges still render on AI buttons (verified '~7 cr' on eg-loop Get AI Recommendation, '~20 cr' on eg-session Generate Breakthrough Report). Pill tap-to-navigate-to-/ai-wallet could not be confirmed via Playwright mouse.click coordinate (likely RN Web touch-vs-mouse handler), but onPress is wired in shared AiCreditsBadge.tsx and component is identical to prior validated usage.
critical_code_review_comments: AiCreditsBadge usage is consistent (compact + autoRefresh) across all 5 EG tool screens — clean implementation.
All 5 screens use a shared headerTop pattern (flexDirection:row, justifyContent:space-between) so the pill sits naturally next to the back button — visually consistent.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 draft EG sessions (TEST_trap=EG-84124B02F1, TEST_loop=EG-E109DF2052, TEST_limitation=EG-D62D7E4AB8, TEST_aim=EG-52C2802605) via POST /api/emotional-gatekeeper/sessions as the super_admin user, used purely for navigating into the tool screens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header AI-credits pill confirmed rendering on all 5 EG tool screens (eg-trap, eg-loop, eg-limitation, eg-aim, eg-session). Component used: AiCreditsBadge compact autoRefresh — fetches /api/ai-wallet via useAiWalletStore and pushes /ai-wallet on tap. To bypass the EG-flow navigation, you can pre-create draft sessions via POST /api/emotional-gatekeeper/sessions {session_type:'trap|loop|limitation|aim'} and navigate directly to /tools/eg-<type>?sessionId=<id>.
